title: Pure T.G.
summary: Pure T.G. (Tech Genus) Accel Synchro strategy based on Antinomy's futuristic cybernetic arsenal, utilizing 2023 support to orchestrate explosive multi-Synchro combo turns without needing Assault Mode cards. By converting destroyed pieces into searches and swarming through T.G. Rocket Salamander and T.G. All Clear, the deck summons colossal Level 10 and 12 Delta Accel Synchros that banish and negate.

summary.title: Starters
points: T.G. Rocket Salamander tributes a T.G. monster you control to Special Summon a T.G. monster with a different name from your Deck, and targets a Level 4 or lower T.G. in your GY to Special Summon it in Defense Position.

T.G. Limiter Removal adds 2 T.G. monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, then discards 1 card, and can banish itself from GY to shuffle a T.G. from GY into the Deck or add it to hand.

T.G. All Clear Continuous Spell treats all face-up T.G. monsters as Machines, grants an additional Normal Summon of a T.G. monster each turn, and destroys 1 T.G. monster you control to search a T.G. monster with a different name from your Deck or GY.
T.G. Screw Serpent revives a Level 4 or lower T.G. monster from your GY on Normal or Special Summon, and banishes itself from the GY to modulate a T.G. monster's Level by up to 2.
T.G. Striker and T.G. Warwolf easily Special Summon themselves from hand to provide instant Tuner and non-Tuner materials.

summary.title: Opening: Rocket Salamander + All Clear
steps: Activate T.G. All Clear to grant an additional Normal Summon and treat your T.G. monsters as Machines.
Normal Summon T.G. Rocket Salamander and tribute it to Special Summon T.G. Screw Serpent from your Deck.
Activate Screw Serpent's effect to revive T.G. Rocket Salamander from your GY.
Synchro Summon T.G. Mighty Striker using Screw Serpent and Rocket Salamander, searching T.G. Limiter Removal or T.G. Close.
Link Summon T.G. Trident Launcher using Mighty Striker and extenders to Special Summon 3 T.G. monsters from your hand, Deck, and GY simultaneously.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: T.G. Glaive Blaster is a Level 12 Synchro boss that can banish an opponent's Special Summoned monster from the Extra Deck once per turn as a Quick Effect for each non-Tuner Synchro used as material, and Special Summons banished monsters to your field.
T.G. Halberd Cannon negates the summon of a monster once per turn as a Quick Effect and destroys it, and floats into a T.G. Synchro Monster when it leaves the field.
Shooting Star Dragon T.G. EX negates a monster effect that targets a monster you control and negates an opponent's attack, made easily using Accel Synchro climbs.
T.G. Over Dragonar Special Summons any number of T.G. monsters from your GY in Defense Position upon Synchro Summon, refueling your entire board for Delta Accel plays.
Satellite Warrior destroys opponent's cards on Synchro Summon up to the number of Synchro Monsters in your GY, gaining 1000 ATK for each.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: T.G. Close Counter Trap negates the activation of an opponent's Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect and destroys it while you control a Machine T.G. monster, and recycles itself to hand when a T.G. Synchro is banished.
Sonic Stun negates an opponent's attack and Special Summons a T.G. monster or Level 4 or lower Tuner directly from your hand or Deck.
T.G. Mighty Striker and T.G. Wonder Magician can perform Synchro Summons during your opponent's Main Phase as Quick Effects.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: T.G. Halberd Cannon/Assault Mode is excluded because it requires Assault Mode Activate, which is not run in this pure build.

exclude.T.G. Halberd Cannon/Assault Mode: Needs Assault Mode Activate, which the pure list doesn't play.
